$comment: GET /v1/pages/{page_id}/markdown from Notion's 2026-03-11 reference. This endpoint returns the page's content as Notion-flavored Markdown in one response, rather than requiring callers to recursively traverse the deeply nested block tree.
title: Notion page Markdown
description: Retrieve a Notion page's content as enhanced Markdown.
$sideEffectsComment: This is a read-only GET. Replaying it does not alter the page, and no idempotency key applies.

config.label: Page ID
config.description: The Notion page UUID, with or without hyphens. The connection must have Read content capability and access to this page.

config.label: Include transcript
config.description: Include meeting-note transcripts when the connection and caller are permitted to read them.
config.$comment: The wire name is include_transcript even though generated package config uses includeTranscript. It defaults false because transcripts can contain substantially more sensitive content than the page body.

outputShape.description: The literal response object type, page_markdown.
The page content in Notion enhanced Markdown.
Whether the returned Markdown was truncated.
Block ids whose types could not be represented in Markdown.

$outputComment: Notion returns the page_markdown object directly at the response top level, not under data, result or page. The connector runtime exposes that body under data.

contract.$comment: The path and query inputs sent and the complete documented top-level response fields read. Declaring both sides keeps drift checking explicit even though Notion publishes no machine-readable spec.
